title: Nike Signs Two-Time World Champion Diana Flores, Growing Its Flag Football Roster
summary: Nike is welcoming Diana Flores, two-time flag football world champion, NFL and International Federation of American Football (IFAF) Global Flag Ambassador, and captain and quarterback of Mexico’s national flag football team, to its roster of athletes.
body_markdown:
Nike is welcoming Flores to its athlete family, launching a new chapter with one of flag football’s most dynamic global stars as the sport prepares for its Olympic debut at Los Angeles 2028.


A Mexico City native, Flores began playing flag football at age 8 and earned a spot on her country’s national team by 16. Now, as captain and quarterback of Mexico’s national flag football team, she is shaping the future of the game. A two-time world champion and global flag football ambassador for the NFL and the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), she has helped grow the sport worldwide, inspiring athletes and breaking cultural and gender barriers along the way.


For Flores, the Nike partnership carries personal significance. Growing up in Mexico, some of her first cleats were Nikes, although back then, she couldn’t have imagined that she’d one day be representing the brand herself. Now, she hopes to use her partnership to open doors for the next generation of athletes.


“It means a lot to me to start this new chapter with Nike and join forces to continue moving flag football forward,” says Flores. “My mission has always been to make this sport more accessible for girls around the world and help them see that their dreams aren’t out of reach. Together, we have an opportunity to break down barriers, create new pathways and inspire the next generation to believe in what’s possible.”


Flores has turned her passion for flag football into a driving force in its global expansion, championing the sport’s inclusion in the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles, where she will compete for gold as a Nike athlete. In addition, she will provide input to Nike’s suite of flag football products currently in development and future projects.


As an established leader in flag football, Nike has helped expand access, elevate performance and support the athletes, communities and culture that move the game forward. Bringing Flores into the Nike athlete family is a natural next step in advancing this work.


On November 21, Flores made her debut as a Nike athlete at The Block, Nike’s newest flag football platform, where music, streetwear, food and culture collide on the field. Staged alongside select NFL international games, The Block reimagines the sport in a way only Nike can, putting elite co-ed teams into fast-paced, 5v5 tournament-style play and bringing the game to unexpected places. At the Mexico City event, Flores took the field as team captain, leading the way from her first moment in the Swoosh.


Flores will continue to shape and expand Nike’s growing flag football initiatives, playing a key role in advancing the brand’s efforts to elevate the sport on a global platform.


“Flag football is opening the game to more athletes than ever, and with Diana Flores leading the charge, Nike is helping define what comes next,” says Ann Miller, Executive Vice President of Global Sports Marketing at Nike. “As the sport steps onto the global stage at the 2028 Olympics, Nike is proud to stand with Diana as she competes, grows the game and unlocks possibilities for a new generation of athletes around the world.”


Flores’ influence extends far beyond the field, earning her the Women’s Sports Foundation’s “Re-Writing the Game” Award in 2025 and a seat on the organization’s Board of Trustees. Most recently, Flores was named to this year’s TIME100 Most Influential People in Sports list, cementing her status as one of the most impactful athletes in the world and a global champion for flag football’s historic growth.


Flores joins Nike’s growing roster of flag football athletes, including Darrell “Housh” Doucette, Maci Joncich, Sara Parker, Antony Auclair and Janasia Wilson.


Beyond its athlete partnerships, Nike is investing in the future of flag football through initiatives that expand access and support the sport’s development worldwide. The brand is supporting national and developmental teams; collaborating with athletes to inform new product innovations; and creating more opportunities for the next generation, especially girls. In the United States, Nike has partnered with the NFL since 2021 on a $5 million grant initiative dedicated to growing girls’ flag football in high school athletics.
